entities.name: PMID:25085593
observations: 2014 experimental study titled “Zuo Jin Wan reverses P-gp-mediated drug-resistance by inhibiting activation of the PI3K/Akt/NF-κB pathway.” In HCT116/L-OHP colorectal cancer cells, ZJW enhanced chemotherapy sensitivity and oxaliplatin-induced apoptosis; ZJW and LY294002 reduced Akt Ser473 and NF-κB phosphorylation, while a PI3K/Akt activator weakened these effects. Accessible abstract reports P-gp protein and ABCB1 mRNA assessment but does not establish a P-gp efflux result.

entities.name: ZJW pathway resistance reversal
observations: In acquired oxaliplatin-resistant HCT116/L-OHP cells, Zuo Jin Wan sensitized cells and increased oxaliplatin-induced apoptosis; reduced Akt Ser473 and NF-κB phosphorylation; and its effects were weakened by PI3K/Akt activation. This supports pharmacologic pathway involvement, but not a fully established P-gp transport mechanism.
